POWER MECHANICS — MOCK EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Project, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Project.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project.

2. When learning Properties and application of Materials in Power mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Properties and application of Materials in Power mechanics.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Properties and application of Materials in Power mechanics.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Properties and application of Materials in Power mechanics.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Properties and application of Materials in Power mechanics.

3. When learning Suspension system, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Suspension system.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Suspension system.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Suspension system.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Suspension system.

4. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Input Cable Tester

5. When learning Steering system, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Steering system.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Steering system.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Steering system.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Steering system.

6. When learning Principles of Power Mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Principles of Power Mechanics.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Principles of Power Mechanics.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Principles of Power Mechanics.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Principles of Power Mechanics.

7. When learning Orthographic projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Orthographic projection.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Orthographic projection.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Orthographic projection.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic projection.

8. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Run with the tool
   D. Work alone with eyes closed

9. When learning Isometric projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Isometric projection.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Isometric projection.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Isometric projection.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Isometric projection.

10. When learning ISO Thread forms, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after ISO Thread forms.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for ISO Thread forms.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for ISO Thread forms.
   D. Skip safety briefings for ISO Thread forms.

11. When learning Limits, fits and tolerance, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Limits, fits and tolerance.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Limits, fits and tolerance.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Limits, fits and tolerance.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Limits, fits and tolerance.

12. When learning Metalwork processes in power mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Metalwork processes in power mechanics.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Metalwork processes in power mechanics.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Metalwork processes in power mechanics.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Metalwork processes in power mechanics.

13. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Monitor
   C. Keyboard
   D. Speaker

14. When learning Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.

15. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

16. When learning Braking system, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Braking system.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Braking system.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Braking system.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Braking system.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Four- Stroke Petrol Engine and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Two-stroke petrol engine and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Two- Stroke Petrol Engine and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Petrol fuel Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

24. In three clear sentences, explain Metalwork processes in power mechanics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
